name: S&P 500 Opening Range Breakout Whipsaw Analysis
description: Research study analyzing how often the S&P 500 Index experiences **whipsaw behavior** after the opening range (09:30-09:45 ET). When price breaks out in one direction from the opening range, what percentage of the time does it also break out in the opposite direction during the same trading day?
source:
# =============================================================================
# S&P 500 OPENING RANGE BREAKOUT WHIPSAW ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Research Question: When price breaks out from the opening range (09:30-09:45 ET),
# what percentage of time does it also break out in the OPPOSITE direction
# during the same trading day (whipsaw behavior)?
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE - S&P 500 INDEX ===
src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.SPX, timeframe=1Min)()
high = src.h
low = src.l
open_price = src.o
close = src.c

# === OPENING RANGE SESSION (09:30-09:45 ET) ===
opening_range = session_window(session=Session(start='09:30', end='09:45', tz='America/New_York'))()
or_high = opening_range.high
or_low = opening_range.low
or_open = opening_range.open
or_closed = opening_range.closed

# Forward-fill opening range levels through the trading day
or_high_filled = ffill_day()(or_high)
or_low_filled = ffill_day()(or_low)
or_open_filled = ffill_day()(or_open)

# Opening range size (percentage)
or_range_pct = ((or_high - or_low) / or_open) * 100

# === ANALYSIS WINDOW (09:45-20:00 ET) ===
analysis_window = session_window(session=Session(start='09:45', end='20:00', tz='America/New_York'))()
in_analysis = analysis_window.active

# === BREAKOUT DETECTION ===
# Upside breakout: high touches above opening range high
upside_break_bar = in_analysis and (high > or_high_filled)

# Downside breakout: low touches below opening range low
downside_break_bar = in_analysis and (low < or_low_filled)

# === DAILY AGGREGATION - Did breakout occur during analysis session? ===
upside_occurred = session_agg(session=Session(start='09:45', end='20:00', tz='America/New_York'), agg=AggregationType.Any)(upside_break_bar)
downside_occurred = session_agg(session=Session(start='09:45', end='20:00', tz='America/New_York'), agg=AggregationType.Any)(downside_break_bar)

# === BREAKOUT CLASSIFICATION ===
# Whipsaw: both upside AND downside breakouts occurred
both_breakouts = upside_occurred and downside_occurred

# Clean breakouts: only one direction
upside_only = upside_occurred and (downside_occurred == False)
downside_only = downside_occurred and (upside_occurred == False)

# No breakout at all
no_breakout = (upside_occurred == False) and (downside_occurred == False)

# Any breakout occurred
any_breakout = upside_occurred or downside_occurred

# === RANGE SIZE COMPARISON ===
# Opening range size on whipsaw days vs non-whipsaw days
range_on_whipsaw = where(both_breakouts, or_range_pct)
range_on_clean = where(any_breakout and (both_breakouts == False), or_range_pct)

# === CUMULATIVE WHIPSAW COUNT ===
whipsaw_count_cum = cumulative(agg=sum)(where(both_breakouts, 1.0))

# === TIME EXTRACTION FOR DAILY TABLE ===
bar_idx = index()
date_stamp = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.date, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_idx)

# Daily values - filter to opening range close bars for clean daily data
or_high_daily = where(or_closed, or_high)
or_low_daily = where(or_closed, or_low)
or_range_daily = where(or_closed, or_range_pct)
upside_daily = where(or_closed, upside_occurred)
downside_daily = where(or_closed, downside_occurred)
whipsaw_daily = where(or_closed, both_breakouts)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD - CATEGORY 1: KEY METRICS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Whipsaw Analysis Summary',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Whipsaw Rate',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                dp=1,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,
                card_color=Color.Error,
                info='% of breakout days where BOTH directions triggered'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Total Breakout Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details,
                info='Days with at least one directional breakout'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Whipsaw Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details,
                card_color=Color.Warning,
                info='Days with both upside AND downside breakouts'
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Clean Breakout Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_slot=CardSlot.Details,
                card_color=Color.Success,
                info='Days with only one directional breakout'
            )
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(
    where(any_breakout, where(both_breakouts, 1.0)),
    where(any_breakout, 1.0),
    where(both_breakouts, 1.0),
    where((upside_only or downside_only), 1.0)
)

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Breakout Direction Breakdown',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Upside Only Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Success
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Downside Only Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Error
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='Both Directions',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Warning
            ),
            ColumnSpec(
                title='No Breakout Days',
                card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
                card_color=Color.Muted
            )
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Summary'
)(
    where(upside_only, 1.0),
    where(downside_only, 1.0),
    where(both_breakouts, 1.0),
    where(no_breakout, 1.0)
)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD - CATEGORY 2: DISTRIBUTION CHARTS
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Breakout Pattern Distribution',
    category='2. Distribution',
    x_axis_label='Breakout Type',
    y_axis_label='Number of Days',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat,
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Upside Only', color=Color.Success),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Downside Only', color=Color.Error),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Both (Whipsaw)', color=Color.Warning),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='No Breakout', color=Color.Muted)
    ])
)(
    where(upside_only, 1.0),
    where(downside_only, 1.0),
    where(both_breakouts, 1.0),
    where(no_breakout, 1.0)
)

xy_bars(
    title='Average Opening Range Size: Whipsaw vs Clean Breakouts',
    category='2. Distribution',
    x_axis_label='Day Type',
    y_axis_label='Avg Range Size (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Whipsaw Days', color=Color.Warning),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Clean Breakout Days', color=Color.Success)
    ])
)(range_on_whipsaw, range_on_clean)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD - CATEGORY 3: TIME SERIES
# =============================================================================

timeseries_lines(
    title='Cumulative Whipsaw Occurrences Over Time',
    category='3. Time Series',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative Whipsaw Count', color=Color.Warning, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid)
    ])
)(whipsaw_count_cum)

histogram(
    title='Opening Range Size Distribution (All Days)',
    category='3. Time Series',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    x_axis_label='Range Size (%)',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat
)(or_range_pct)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD - CATEGORY 4: DETAILED DATA
# =============================================================================

detailed_table(
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Daily Opening Range Breakout Details',
        include_timestamp=True,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Range %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Upside Break', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Downside Break', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Whipsaw', type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Daily Data'
)(or_high_daily, or_low_daily, or_range_daily, upside_daily, downside_daily, whipsaw_daily)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Statistical Summary',
        col_headers=['Count', 'Percentage'],
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='Total Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Breakout Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Whipsaw Days', agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            RowSpec(name='Whipsaw Rate', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, color=Color.Warning)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Daily Data'
)(
    where(or_closed, 1.0),
    where(or_closed, 1.0),
    where(any_breakout, 1.0),
    where(any_breakout, 1.0),
    where(both_breakouts, 1.0),
    where(both_breakouts, 1.0),
    where(any_breakout, where(both_breakouts, 1.0)),
    where(any_breakout, where(both_breakouts, 1.0))
)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Opening Range Established',
        icon=Icon.ClockIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Range High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Range Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Range Size %', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(or_closed, or_high, or_low, or_range_pct)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Whipsaw Events',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Whipsaw Day', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='OR High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='OR Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(both_breakouts, where(both_breakouts, 'Both Directions'), or_high_filled, or_low_filled)
